user.title: Add DingTalk robot
user.description: Paste the access token of the custom robot, or the complete webhook URL from the DingTalk console. A webhook with a signing secret enabled also needs that secret.

data_description.token: The `access_token` parameter of the robot webhook.
data_description.secret: The `SEC...` value from the security settings, only when "Sign" is enabled.

data_description.token: The `access_token` parameter of the robot webhook.
data_description.secret: The `SEC...` value from the security settings, only when "Sign" is enabled.

error.invalid_token: No access token found. Paste the token itself or the complete webhook URL.
error.invalid_secret: The signing secret cannot contain spaces.

data_description.timeout: How long to wait for the DingTalk webhook, in seconds.
data_description.retry: How often a failing request is retried. Use 0 to disable retries.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach the DingTalk webhook: {error}

unexpected_response.message: The DingTalk webhook returned an unexpected response.

link_url_required.message: A DingTalk link message requires a message URL.

card_action_required.message: A DingTalk action card requires buttons, or a single button.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a message to a DingTalk robot, including the options that the generic `notify.send_message` action cannot carry.

message.name: Message
message.description: The message body. Markdown is supported by the markdown and action card message types.

title.name: Title
title.description: Message title. Markdown messages get it as a `## ` heading at the top of the body and as the notification preview; link and action card messages use it as the notification preview; text messages get it as the first line of the body.

at_all.name: Mention everyone
at_all.description: Mention every member of the group. Only used by text and markdown messages.

at_mobiles.name: Mention phone numbers
at_mobiles.description: Phone numbers to mention. Only used by text and markdown messages.

pic_url.name: Picture URL
pic_url.description: Thumbnail of a link message, or the cover image of an action card.

message_url.name: Message URL
message_url.description: Target URL of a link message. Required for the link message type.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Buttons of an action card, each with a `title` and a `url`.

button_layout.name: Button layout
button_layout.description: How the buttons of an action card are laid out.

single_title.name: Single button title
single_title.description: Title of the single button of an action card, used together with the single button URL.

single_url.name: Single button URL
single_url.description: URL of the single button of an action card, used together with the single button title.
